title: Processing a malformed RRC message leads to an out-of-bounds read, resulting in a denial-of-service… (CVE-2026-48175)
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-48175 involves processing a malformed RRC message that causes an out-of-bounds read, leading to a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. This flaw can disrupt normal operation by causing the affected system to crash or become unresponsive.
